Country coat of arms images are downloaded from MainFacts:
https://mainfacts.com/

REST Countries documents the coatOfArms field as MainFacts SVG/PNG URLs:
https://restcountries.com/docs

For this game the PNG files were resized locally to a maximum side of 320 px
and then converted to near-lossless WebP (cwebp 1.6.0), 6.0 MB instead of
20.1 MB for all 193:

  cwebp -near_lossless 20 xx.png -o xx.webp

Near-lossless, not lossy: lossy WebP stores colour at half resolution, and on
flat heraldic art that blurs thin coloured lines (sun rays, star outlines,
waves). Raising the lossy quality does not help: at -q 95 Brazil stays at
26 dB PSNR, while -near_lossless 20 gives at least 37 dB for every coat
(median 40) and is still smaller than lossy -q 90. Levels 20-39 produce identical files.
Fully transparent and fully opaque pixels stay exact; only anti-aliased
edges shift by a few alpha levels. The embedded ICC profiles were all plain
sRGB, so dropping them does not shift colours.

Antarctica (aq) is left out on purpose: under that code MainFacts serves the
arms of the British Antarctic Territory, and Antarctica itself has none.

Seychelles (sc): the MainFacts PNG is cut off, the lower half of the arms is
transparent. sc.webp was rebuilt from the SVG instead. WebKit (qlmanage)
rendered it on a white and on a black page, the alpha channel was recovered
from the difference of the two renders (alpha = 1 - (white - black), colour
= black / alpha), and the result was trimmed, resized to 320 px and encoded
with the same cwebp command as above.

The zoom window in the atlas uses the MainFacts SVG files as they are, in
../coats-svg/ (61 MB for 193, about 16 MB gzipped on the wire). They are not
part of the offline cache: see ONLINE_ONLY in detective/tools/gen-sw.py.
kg.svg was re-encoded from UTF-16 to UTF-8, which halves it; nothing else
was changed. Every SVG was rendered in WebKit and compared with its 320 px coat
by PSNR (median 30 dB); the 29 least similar were also checked by eye, and
apart from the cut-off Seychelles PNG they all show the same arms.
